verdict.line: You lose if you eat a charged Q alone in brush range with no minions to back up your E; you win if you catch his Q wind-up with E and dump W into his face.

brief.thesis: This is a 51.6% matchup over 190 games because both champions win through forced short trades rather than sustained poke: Sion's whole kit revolves around landing one charged Q (Cryptic Gaze, 550 range, 12/11/10/9/8s cooldown) to set up a kill, while Sett's whole kit revolves around punishing exactly that commitment with E (Facebreaker) into W (Haymaker). Whoever lands their engage first usually wins the exchange. Sett also holds the recorded solo-kill edge, which matches his earlier spike item timing against Sion's slower max-HP scaling.

theirWindow.when: he fully charges Q from brush
theirWindow.what: If it lands clean you're stunned and he follows with Enrage (E) autos, trading his health for AD to burst you down before Second Wind can heal it off.

yourWindow.when: he commits to charging Q in melee range
yourWindow.what: Walk so a minion sits on the opposite side of Sett from Sion, then E (Facebreaker) to pull both in — with only Sion on one side the pull just slows him, but with a minion on the far side it stuns and cancels his charge. Follow with W (Haymaker) aimed so he's in the true-damage center, then Q (Knuckle Down) for bonus damage off his max health.

start.why: 87.1% pick rate at 49.5% win rate — the sustained-damage start matches the short-trade nature of this lane better than the shield start.

boots.why: 51% win rate over 102 games; Sion leans on Enrage autos and Cannibalism attack speed, so flat physical damage reduction blunts both.

core.why: The slow-on-hit lets you actually stick Q's bonus damage and W's true-damage center on him instead of watching him walk out after a stun.
Sion's base armor and Steelcaps will wall you off without the shred — this is what keeps your late trades relevant.

situational.when: he's building toward a full all-in with Cannibalism up and you need to survive the burst window
he's stacked a lot of max HP off minion and champion kills with Enrage and you need the current-health damage to cut through it

runes.keystoneWhy: Run on both top rune pages for this matchup (55.6% and 45.2% win rate) — the sustained stacks reward you for staying in extended trades rather than poking and backing off.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 74.6% and backs up the recorded solo-kill advantage you already hold in this matchup; Flash+Teleport (55.6% win rate, 22.5% pick) is the alternative if you expect the lane to be decided by sidelane pressure instead.

playing.title: Bait the Q, don't block it
playing.detail: Stand just outside 550 range near brush so he's tempted to charge Q at you. The charge-up stance is your cue to walk in with E rather than retreat.

playing.title: Pull with a minion on the far side
playing.detail: Facebreaker (E) only stuns when enemies are on opposite sides of Sett — if Sion is alone on one side it's just a slow. Position with a minion behind him before you commit E.

playing.title: Center your W on him
playing.detail: Haymaker's true damage only lands in the center of the punch; the sides are weaker physical damage. Aim the cast so Sion eats the center, not the edge.

playing.title: Punish his E toggle on minions
playing.detail: Enrage drains his own health while he's using it to farm, even though it also grows his max HP permanently on kills. Walk up and trade while he's mid-wave with E on and low from the self-damage.

playing.title: Save E for his W shield windows
playing.detail: Death's Caress absorbs damage until it explodes; don't dump your stun into a full shield. Wait for it to pop or bait him into detonating it early before you engage.

playing.title: Respect Cannibalism after level 6
playing.detail: Once his ultimate is up, prolonged trades heal him and buff his attack speed. Front-load damage with Q plus a centered W rather than extending the fight.

playing.title: Look for the R pick near brush edges
playing.detail: The Show Stopper has a 120/100/80/80/80s cooldown and 400 range — use it to catch him overextending after a missed Q, not as a follow-up to your own E stun.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/sample-size figures above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup read — why the trades play out this way, the E-stun positioning requirement, and the timing windows — is my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Sion’s fully charged (Q) used from inside a brush. Interrupt his (Q) charge with [E] while hitting him at the center of [W].
